title: Implement namespace normalization for Fabric Data and Logging in setup pages and platform management
summary: Fabric table and schema names are now normalized to lowercase in setup pages to ensure consistent handling across case-sensitive file systems and data platforms. New setup records use lowercase defaults (businesscentral and businesscentral_log) while existing values remain unchanged.
key_points: Namespace fields normalize user input to lowercase when saved through the UI or API
New setup records automatically use lowercase defaults to avoid casing mismatches in Fabric landing zones
Existing stored namespace values are not migrated, preventing disruption to already-exported tables and models
Added comprehensive tests validating lowercase normalization behavior
Direct AL writes bypassing page validation may still store uppercase values
quote: Using lowercase consistently avoids mismatches when data is accessed through both case-insensitive T-SQL and potentially case-sensitive Spark.
